task: Give critical release-unit children a machine-derived proof surface from current Known Failure regression authority when direct Atlas test edges are absent, and permit only receipt-bound canonical child-plan digest refresh during fresh reconciliation.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Live bounded rehearsal replay job 112662284959 reached the new two-pass child-plan reprojection successfully and eliminated prior subsystem, negative-knowledge and guard-digest drift, but U01 remained STALE because a fixture-only critical child has no direct Atlas test edge and therefore its reprojected semanticExecutionRoute.proof is empty. The same fresh reprojection necessarily changes childPlanDigest, which current obligation drift treats as hard drift even when material obligations are unchanged.
observableOutcomes: Canonical child proof is the deterministic union of direct Atlas proof files and regressionTests attached to the current projected Known Failure set.
Fixture/config/data-only children receive non-empty proof when current Knowledge authority supplies applicable regression tests; no rehearsal-specific test path is hard-coded.
Initial child transaction generation and fresh child reprojection use the same proof derivation.
Fresh reevaluation emits a receipt binding the persisted origin childPlanDigest to the exact reprojected childPlanDigest, projection contract, candidate head and current main.
Reconciliation may ignore childPlanDigest drift only when that receipt exactly binds the old and new digests; requiredEvidence and every material obligation remain hard drift.
Missing proof after both Atlas and Known Failure derivation remains fail-closed.
unresolvedRisks: Using every repository test as fallback would create unbounded and semantically weak proof.
Allowing arbitrary childPlanDigest drift would permit stale or forged child plans.
Updating requiredEvidence.proofFiles during recovery would weaken the existing proof-ownership drift invariant.
A forged refresh receipt must not authorize material, evidence-ownership or risk drift.

in: Derive current regression proof files from getAllFailures() using projected active failure IDs.
Union regression proof with Atlas proof in top-level childPlanProjection and per-unit child semantic routes.
Do not mutate manifest requiredEvidence.proofFiles as part of policy reprojection.
Bind a canonical child-plan refresh receipt during trusted successor reevaluation.
Allow only receipt-bound childPlanDigest drift in reconcileSuccessorReleaseUnit while retaining hard drift for all other execution obligations.
Add regressions for fixture-only proof fallback, valid digest refresh, forged/missing receipt rejection, and unchanged requiredEvidence drift behavior.
out: No manual parent-proof copying or stderr parsing.
No relaxation of requiredEvidence, material scope, operations, dependency, risk, forbidden/read-only, predecessor or PR identity checks.
No direct persisted state edit, blocker clear, child PR creation or receipt fabrication.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This changes proof authority and one reconciliation drift category inside the trusted release executor. The proof source must be machine-derived and digest refresh must be explicitly bound without weakening material obligations.

acceptanceCriteria: Plan projection derives regression proof only from current projected failure IDs and canonical Known Failure regressionTests.
Per-unit child plan proof uses the same derivation and critical fixture-only units no longer have empty proof when applicable regression authority exists.
If both direct Atlas proof and regression proof are empty, strict critical Plan validation still BLOCKs.

Trusted fresh reevaluation attaches a refresh receipt with originPlanDigest equal to the persisted execution manifest child plan digest and refreshedPlanDigest equal to the final fresh manifest child plan digest.
reconcileSuccessorReleaseUnit accepts childPlanDigest-only drift only with a valid exact receipt and unchanged hard obligations.
Changing requiredEvidence.proofFiles without matching prior authority remains RELEASE_UNIT_EXECUTION_OBLIGATION_DRIFT.
Exact-head CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle close before merge, then the unchanged rehearsal resumes from state 4a07ce44ba4edf2fcb5c537934c9b20a8737281d.
invariants: Proof fallback is derived from current Knowledge registry, never manually supplied by the executor.
Projection proof does not widen intendedFiles or operations.
requiredEvidence ownership remains immutable across fresh policy reprojection.
A refresh receipt cannot authorize any drift field other than childPlanDigest.
Receipt origin digest must equal the persisted execution manifest childPlanDigest.
Receipt refreshed digest must equal the fresh manifest childPlanDigest.

failureModes: Fixture-only child has MUST_CREATE and AUTHORITY but no direct Atlas PROOF.
Known Failure fallback accidentally uses failures outside current projected scope.
Fresh policy reprojection changes childPlanDigest and is rejected as indistinguishable hard drift.
Receipt exists but does not bind the persisted origin digest.
A hard requiredEvidence or dependency drift is accidentally accepted alongside digest refresh.
edgeCases: Child has direct Atlas tests and Known Failure regression tests.
Child has no direct tests but multiple active Known Failures share the same regression test.
Child has neither direct nor regression proof and must remain BLOCKED.
STALE order-1 recovery on unchanged main.
Successor child after predecessor merge changes base and child plan digest.

alternatives.summary: Use direct Atlas proof plus current-scope Known Failure regression tests as canonical child proof.
alternatives.reason: Both sources are machine-derived Control Plane authorities and are available during fresh reprojection.

alternatives.summary: Copy parent semanticExecutionRoute.proof into every child.
alternatives.reason: Would preserve manually declared proof even when current child scope or Knowledge applicability changes.

alternatives.summary: Permit critical child routes with empty proof.
alternatives.reason: Would weaken the critical operational-intelligence contract.

alternatives.summary: Ignore evidence and child-plan changes after fresh reevaluation.
alternatives.reason: Would break proof ownership, scope and release authority.

specialistReviews.finding: The missing proof edge is caused by semantic-route topology for non-code units, not by absence of repository-wide regression authority.
specialistReviews.resolution: Derive child proof from current scoped Known Failure regression tests in addition to direct Atlas test edges.

specialistReviews.finding: Permitting child plan digest drift without provenance would let stale or forged planning envelopes bypass execution obligation checks.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require an exact trusted reprojection receipt and permit only the childPlanDigest drift field; all hard obligations remain immutable.

specialistReviews.finding: A current-policy child plan must be able to replace an older policy envelope without changing material release obligations.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep requiredEvidence and material obligations fixed, refresh only plan identity through a receipt-bound successor reevaluation.

specialistReviews.finding: The Knowledge registry already names regression tests for active failures, but Plan semantic routing does not currently consume them as fallback proof.
specialistReviews.resolution: Make active-failure regression tests a deterministic proof source and deduplicate them with direct Atlas proof.

challenge.scenario: A critical child contains only JSON fixtures with no import/test graph edge.
challenge.finding: Atlas PROOF is empty and strict operational validation blocks despite applicable Known Failure regression authority.
challenge.resolution: Union direct Atlas proof with regressionTests from exactly the child projected activeFailureIds.

challenge.scenario: Many active failures reference the same regression test.
challenge.finding: Duplicate proof entries could make identity unstable or noisy.
challenge.resolution: Deduplicate and sort the canonical proof list before embedding it in projection or child route.

challenge.scenario: No direct or Known Failure regression proof exists.
challenge.finding: Inventing a placeholder would create false evidence.
challenge.resolution: Emit an empty proof list and preserve the existing critical Plan BLOCK.

challenge.scenario: Fresh canonical policy changes guard/scope metadata and therefore childPlanDigest while files and operations remain identical.
challenge.finding: Current obligationDrift cannot distinguish safe policy refresh from material drift.
challenge.resolution: Trusted reevaluation emits an exact refresh receipt; reconciliation permits only childPlanDigest drift when receipt origin/new digests match.

challenge.scenario: requiredEvidence.proofFiles changes together with a valid child plan refresh.
challenge.finding: Accepting it would undermine existing proof-ownership drift protection.
challenge.resolution: requiredEvidence remains a hard obligation and any such drift stays STALE regardless of refresh receipt.

challenge.scenario: Receipt claims a different origin digest than the persisted execution manifest.
challenge.finding: The fresh child plan is not a proven continuation of the persisted transaction.

challenge.scenario: Successor base changes after predecessor merge and child plan base metadata is refreshed.
challenge.finding: Digest refresh is expected but must remain bound to exact current main and normal predecessor receipts.
challenge.resolution: Receipt is emitted only after fresh exact-base reevaluation; base and predecessor checks still execute before drift acceptance.

challenge.finding: Fallback must not replace stronger direct semantic evidence.
challenge.resolution: Use a deterministic union, retaining all direct proof and supplementing it with current regression authority.

proofPlan: Commit this plan only and require Plan Before Code PASS.
Implement canonical regression proof derivation, per-unit proof fallback and receipt-bound childPlanDigest refresh.
Add positive and adversarial orchestration/production-surface regressions.
Require exact-head Knowledge, Plan, Edit-Time, Replay, Release Risk, full tests, typecheck, build and Completion Truth PASS.
Close lifecycle with metadata-only commit, merge exact head, verify main CI, then replay the unchanged persisted rehearsal.

requirements.requirement: Critical release-unit children without direct Atlas test edges must receive current machine-derived regression proof authority without weakening material or evidence-ownership drift checks.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A critical child may not be authorized with empty proof authority.
A child-plan refresh receipt may not mask requiredEvidence or material obligation drift.
